images.note: Real screenshot from Confluent's own Control Center documentation, showing the Topics Overview page of a real running Kafka cluster.

imageNote: Found via curl on docs.confluent.io — confirmed the HTML pages are NOT JS-rendered (plain curl reveals real tags with relative _images/ paths). CRITICAL GOTCHA: docs.confluent.io restructured its URLs mid-research (e.g. platform/current/control-center/... now redirects to control-center/current/...) — always resolve a page's relative ../_images/.png path against the REDIRECTED/EFFECTIVE URL (curl -sL -o /dev/null -w '%{url_effective}' ), not the URL you started with, or you'll construct a wrong path that still returns HTTP 200 (Confluent's docs serve an HTML catch-all page with status 200 for a bad image path, not a 404) but Content-Type text/html instead of image/png. ALWAYS verify with curl -sL -o /dev/null -w '%{content_type}' and confirm it says image/png — a 200 status code alone is not enough proof the URL is a real image on this site.
